newsitem.title: USA: Dauphin Technology rolls out computer.
newsitem.headline: Dauphin Technology rolls out computer.

text.p: Dauphin Technology Inc said Tuesday it had introduced its latest hand-held computer, the DTR-2, in several targeted markets.
The DTR-2, which has voice, pen and keyboard recognition capabilities, will be manufactured by Sigmatron International Inc as part of a recently signed agreement, said Dauphin.
Dauphin also said that as of December 2 it had complied with all requirements of its confirmed plan of reorganization. The company emerged from Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in May.
Dauphin designs and markets microcomputer systems.
